description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de IA e Automações em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Blocks está buscando uma pessoa para atuar como Analista de IA e Automações , com foco em aplicar inteligência artificial de forma prática nos processos internos da empresa. Buscamos alguém que não apenas use ferramentas de IA, mas que saiba conectar diferentes ferramentas à IA via MCP para criar fluxos de trabalho que melhorem processos reais dentro da empresa . Essa pessoa precisa gostar de investigar problemas, conversar com diferentes times, entender gargalos, testar soluções, criar automações e acompanhar se essas soluções estão realmente gerando resultados.


Sobre a Blocks

A Blocks é uma empresa de tecnologia, possui um software próprio e se dedica a digitalizar produtos reais em modelos 3D de alta qualidade, fornecendo ferramentas essenciais para otimizar os processos de trabalho de arquitetos, engenheiros e designers de interiores ao redor do mundo.


O que esperamos de você

  • Mapear processos internos dos diferentes times da Blocks e identificar oportunidades de otimização com IA.
  • Acompanhar como as equipes estão utilizando ferramentas de inteligência artificial no dia a dia.
  • Propor, testar e implementar novos fluxos de trabalho com IA.
  • Criar automações utilizando n8n, APIs, webhooks e integrações entre sistemas.
  • Configurar agentes de IA para tarefas específicas da empresa.
  • Implementar integrações com ferramentas externas utilizando MCP — Model Context Protocol.
  • Conectar modelos de IA a sistemas internos, documentos, bases de dados, planilhas, CRMs, plataformas de atendimento, APIs e outras ferramentas utilizadas pela empresa.
  • Criar e organizar prompts, workflows e processos padronizados para uso interno.
  • Treinar e orientar os times sobre boas práticas no uso de IA.
  • Documentar fluxos, integrações, automações e processos implementados.
  • Medir resultados e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos automatizados.
  • Pesquisar novas ferramentas de IA e avaliar sua aplicação prática na empresa.

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Web Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Web Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in WordPress and HubSpot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.


This is not a classic WordPress role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern JavaScript and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.


If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,

brittle WordPress builds, you'll fit right in.


Key Responsibilities

Website Development

  • Design and build production-grade marketing websites in WordPress (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and HubSpot CMS (HubL templating, modules, themes).
  • Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate
  • prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.
  • Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).
  • Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.


API Integrations & Automation Hooks

  • Integrate websites with HubSpot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.
  • Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.
  • Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).


Quality, Performance & SEO

  • Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.
  • Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, HubSpot tracking, server-side events where needed).
  • Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.


Collaboration

  • Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.
  • Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/GitHub), and documentation.
  • Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.


Required Skills

Technical

  • 3+ years building production websites in WordPress (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).
  • Strong HubSpot CMS experience (HubL, modules, themes, forms, smart content).
  • Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.
  • Comfortable in Git/GitHub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.


Modern Web Skills

  • Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).
  • Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).
  • Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).
  • Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).


Bonus Experience

(Not required, but highly valuable)

  • Webflow development experience.
  • Headless WordPress or HubSpot setups (Next.js + WP/HubSpot APIs).
  • Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.
  • Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.
  • E-commerce experience (WooCommerce, Shopify).
  • Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.


Soft Skills

  • Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.
  • Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.
  • Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.
  • Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.


What Success Looks Like

  • In the first 60–90 days, you will:
  • Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.
  • Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).
  • Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (HubSpot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.
  • Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

About Dry Ground AI


Dry Ground AI designs, builds, and maintains AI-powered solutions that accelerate operational velocity for small and mid-sized businesses. Our flagship AI Velocity Plan gives clients a rapid, iterative path from concept to production. You will be the linchpin who keeps those iterations moving forward.

description:

AI Engineer


We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Location : Remote, open to candidates based in Brazil and the Philippines.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development:

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems:

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion.
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks, voice automation, and prompt tuning systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps best practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning, GANs, or edge AI deployments.
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray.
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first.
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engineering Design Specialist - 72123 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Software Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About LINES


LINES is a real-time, community-driven going-out platform — live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Tens of thousands of users rely on us every weekend.


We're scaling fast and migrating from Firebase to a fully owned AWS backend to power real-time feeds, ticketing, and what's next.



What you'll do


  • Design backend systems for real-time, localized, event-driven timelines (Twitter/Instagram-style)
  • Architect feeds: fanout, ranking, filtering, personalization
  • Build performant APIs for mobile and web clients
  • Own features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, deployment, observability
  • Build ticketing flows: inventory, reservations, consistency, concurrency
  • Build ingestion pipelines (scrapers, cron, integrations) for the event database
  • Design data models for high-write, real-time systems
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction
  • Improve infrastructure, reliability, and developer workflows
  • Write short specs — problem, approach, tradeoffs — to move faster, not slower



What we expect


  • Strong backend fundamentals, systems-first mindset
  • Experience with feeds, timelines, ranking, fanout, or personalization
  • Solid distributed systems chops: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, tradeoffs
  • Designs for scale even when the system is still small
  • Hands-on with Redis, and knows when to reach for it
  • Experience with SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar
  • Comfortable with high-write, read-heavy workloads and eventual consistency
  • Pragmatic — ships impact, not over-engineering
  • Thrives in early-stage chaos with shifting priorities
  • Decides with incomplete info and iterates fast
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) without compromising quality



Tech stack


  • Backend: NestJS (Node.js), TypeScript
  • Infra: AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda), Cloudflare
  • Data: Postgres (migrating), Firebase (legacy)
  • Frontend: Next.js, Expo (React Native)
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions



Nice to have


  • Built or scaled social feeds or marketplaces
  • Ticketing, booking, or inventory experience
  • Firebase familiarity (helpful during migration)
  • Real-time systems (chat, live updates, video)
  • React Native or Expo

title: Direct-Response Creative Strategist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Creative Strategist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.

We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.


The role

We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.


What we’re looking for

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.

You should have:

  • 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook
  • A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
  • Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
  • The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
  • Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.


What we offer

Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.

You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.

This is a fully remote position.


One thing worth knowing

There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Engineer


We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Location : Remote, open to candidates based in Brazil and the Philippines.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development:

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems:

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion.
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks, voice automation, and prompt tuning systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps best practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning, GANs, or edge AI deployments.
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray.
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first.
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

Remoto | Projeto estruturado | Início imediato

Escopo da Prestação de Serviço

  • Diagramação de material principal (~300 páginas);

  • Organização visual de conteúdo previamente estruturado;

  • Domínio avançado real de Canva Pro;
  • Domínio do Pacote Adobe (uso profissional);
  • Experiência comprovada em diagramação de books, relatórios ou materiais corporativos extensos;
  • Estruturação visual com foco em leitura e hierarquia de informação;
  • Capacidade de desenvolver Canva Packs do zero (não adaptados).


É obrigatório que o prestador possua licenças ativas e próprias das ferramentas (Canva Pro e Adobe).



Modelo de Prestação de Serviço

  • Contratação como pessoa jurídica (PJ) / freelancer;
  • Remuneração por hora efetivamente trabalhada - R$ 16,25 por hora com referência de até R$ 650 semanais;
  • A execução das horas ocorre com autonomia de organização, sem exigência de horário fixo, com expectativa de disponibilidade de até 40 horas semanais dedicadas ao projeto;
  • Durante o período de execução das horas registradas, é esperado foco integral na prestação do serviço. Não sendo compatível a execução simultânea de outras atividades durante o período registrado;
  • A Dream Success disponibiliza ao prestador a ferramenta de acompanhamento de produtividade (Jibble), que realiza registro de horas trabalhadas e monitoramento da atividade remota durante o período de execução.


Ao se candidatar, o prestador declara estar ciente e de acordo com:

  • O uso da ferramenta durante a prestação do serviço;
  • O monitoramento integral das horas registradas;
  • As diretrizes aplicáveis de proteção de dados (LGPD).



Fluxo de Avaliação

Nosso processo de avaliação é estruturado para garantir, de forma objetiva, a validação da capacidade técnica e da aderência ao tipo de entrega exigida pelo projeto. As etapas abaixo seguem uma lógica sequencial de profundidade, iniciando pela análise prática e avançando para validação de contexto e execução.


  • Envio obrigatório de portfólio em PDF: O portfólio deve ser anexado diretamente na candidatura via LinkedIn e precisa conter, obrigatoriamente, materiais alinhados ao escopo do projeto, como books, relatórios, apresentações estruturadas ou documentos corporativos extensos. Portfólios com foco em peças criativas, redes sociais ou materiais desalinhados ao contexto não serão considerados.Candidaturas sem portfólio no formato solicitado serão desclassificadas automaticamente.
  • Vídeo de apresentação: Após a triagem inicial, os profissionais selecionados serão convidados a gravar um vídeo de apresentação. O objetivo desta etapa é aprofundar o entendimento sobre sua experiência prática, validar sua participação real nos projetos apresentados e esclarecer eventuais pontos do portfólio.
  • Entrevista com o gestor do projeto: Etapa focada na validação técnica mais aprofundada e no alinhamento sobre padrão de entrega, dinâmica de execução e expectativa de performance dentro do projeto.
  • Início imediato: Profissionais aprovados seguem para início imediato da prestação de serviço.



Perfil Esperado

Este projeto exige um perfil de atuação específico, com foco em execução estruturada e previsível. Abaixo estão os principais comportamentos e competências esperadas para uma boa performance nesse contexto:


  • Organização e método de trabalho: Capacidade de operar com estrutura, lógica e padronização ao longo de todo o material.
  • Disciplina em projetos extensos: Manter consistência visual e qualidade ao longo de grande volume de páginas.
  • Precisão na aplicação de diretrizes: Seguir brand kit e orientações com rigor, sem desvios de padrão.
  • Foco em execução e entrega: Capacidade de transformar conteúdo estruturado em material visual claro, funcional e consistente.



Importante

Antes de avançar, é importante deixar claro o tipo de perfil que não tende a performar bem neste projeto . Os pontos abaixo existem para evitar desalinhamento de expectativa durante a execução:


  • Perfil criativo/autoral como foco principal: Este projeto não prioriza liberdade criativa, e sim execução dentro de padrão definido.
  • Ausência de experiência com materiais corporativos: A falta de vivência com esse tipo de entrega impacta diretamente na qualidade esperada.
  • Domínio superficial das ferramentas exigidas: É necessário uso prático e avançado de Canva Pro e Pacote Adobe.
  • Dificuldade em manter constância produtiva: Projetos extensos exigem ritmo, organização e continuidade.



Direcionamento Final

Se você busca participar de projetos estruturados, com alto nível de exigência e impacto real na entrega ao cliente, essa é uma oportunidade para atuar com profundidade e consistência em um material relevante.


Do nosso lado, garantimos um processo de avaliação ágil e respeitoso com seu tempo. Desde já, agradecemos sua atenção e interesse

title: Senior Web Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Web Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in WordPress and HubSpot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.


This is not a classic WordPress role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern JavaScript and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.


If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,

brittle WordPress builds, you'll fit right in.


Key Responsibilities

Website Development

  • Design and build production-grade marketing websites in WordPress (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and HubSpot CMS (HubL templating, modules, themes).
  • Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate
  • prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.
  • Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).
  • Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.


API Integrations & Automation Hooks

  • Integrate websites with HubSpot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.
  • Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.
  • Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).


Quality, Performance & SEO

  • Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.
  • Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, HubSpot tracking, server-side events where needed).
  • Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.


Collaboration

  • Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.
  • Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/GitHub), and documentation.
  • Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.


Required Skills

Technical

  • 3+ years building production websites in WordPress (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).
  • Strong HubSpot CMS experience (HubL, modules, themes, forms, smart content).
  • Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.
  • Comfortable in Git/GitHub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.


Modern Web Skills

  • Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).
  • Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).
  • Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).
  • Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).


Bonus Experience

(Not required, but highly valuable)

  • Webflow development experience.
  • Headless WordPress or HubSpot setups (Next.js + WP/HubSpot APIs).
  • Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.
  • Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.
  • E-commerce experience (WooCommerce, Shopify).
  • Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.


Soft Skills

  • Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.
  • Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.
  • Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.
  • Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.


What Success Looks Like

  • In the first 60–90 days, you will:
  • Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.
  • Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).
  • Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (HubSpot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.
  • Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Designer Gráfico Freelancer (PJ) | Diagramação de Materiais Corporativos

  • Domínio avançado real de Canva Pro;
  • Domínio do Pacote Adobe (uso profissional);
  • Experiência comprovada em diagramação de books, relatórios ou materiais corporativos extensos;
  • Estruturação visual com foco em leitura e hierarquia de informação;
  • Capacidade de desenvolver Canva Packs do zero (não adaptados).


É obrigatório que o prestador possua licenças ativas e próprias das ferramentas (Canva Pro e Adobe).



Modelo de Prestação de Serviço

  • Contratação como pessoa jurídica (PJ) / freelancer;
  • Remuneração por hora efetivamente trabalhada - R$ 16,25 por hora com referência de até R$ 650 semanais;
  • A execução das horas ocorre com autonomia de organização, sem exigência de horário fixo, com expectativa de disponibilidade de até 40 horas semanais dedicadas ao projeto;
  • Durante o período de execução das horas registradas, é esperado foco integral na prestação do serviço. Não sendo compatível a execução simultânea de outras atividades durante o período registrado;
  • A Dream Success disponibiliza ao prestador a ferramenta de acompanhamento de produtividade (Jibble), que realiza registro de horas trabalhadas e monitoramento da atividade remota durante o período de execução.


Ao se candidatar, o prestador declara estar ciente e de acordo com:

  • O uso da ferramenta durante a prestação do serviço;
  • O monitoramento integral das horas registradas;
  • As diretrizes aplicáveis de proteção de dados (LGPD).



Fluxo de Avaliação

Nosso processo de avaliação é estruturado para garantir, de forma objetiva, a validação da capacidade técnica e da aderência ao tipo de entrega exigida pelo projeto. As etapas abaixo seguem uma lógica sequencial de profundidade, iniciando pela análise prática e avançando para validação de contexto e execução.


  • Envio obrigatório de portfólio em PDF: O portfólio deve ser anexado diretamente na candidatura via LinkedIn e precisa conter, obrigatoriamente, materiais alinhados ao escopo do projeto, como books, relatórios, apresentações estruturadas ou documentos corporativos extensos. Portfólios com foco em peças criativas, redes sociais ou materiais desalinhados ao contexto não serão considerados.Candidaturas sem portfólio no formato solicitado serão desclassificadas automaticamente.
  • Vídeo de apresentação: Após a triagem inicial, os profissionais selecionados serão convidados a gravar um vídeo de apresentação. O objetivo desta etapa é aprofundar o entendimento sobre sua experiência prática, validar sua participação real nos projetos apresentados e esclarecer eventuais pontos do portfólio.
  • Entrevista com o gestor do projeto: Etapa focada na validação técnica mais aprofundada e no alinhamento sobre padrão de entrega, dinâmica de execução e expectativa de performance dentro do projeto.
  • Início imediato: Profissionais aprovados seguem para início imediato da prestação de serviço.



Perfil Esperado

Este projeto exige um perfil de atuação específico, com foco em execução estruturada e previsível. Abaixo estão os principais comportamentos e competências esperadas para uma boa performance nesse contexto:


  • Organização e método de trabalho: Capacidade de operar com estrutura, lógica e padronização ao longo de todo o material.
  • Disciplina em projetos extensos: Manter consistência visual e qualidade ao longo de grande volume de páginas.
  • Precisão na aplicação de diretrizes: Seguir brand kit e orientações com rigor, sem desvios de padrão.
  • Foco em execução e entrega: Capacidade de transformar conteúdo estruturado em material visual claro, funcional e consistente.



Importante

Antes de avançar, é importante deixar claro o tipo de perfil que não tende a performar bem neste projeto . Os pontos abaixo existem para evitar desalinhamento de expectativa durante a execução:


  • Perfil criativo/autoral como foco principal: Este projeto não prioriza liberdade criativa, e sim execução dentro de padrão definido.
  • Ausência de experiência com materiais corporativos: A falta de vivência com esse tipo de entrega impacta diretamente na qualidade esperada.
  • Domínio superficial das ferramentas exigidas: É necessário uso prático e avançado de Canva Pro e Pacote Adobe.
  • Dificuldade em manter constância produtiva: Projetos extensos exigem ritmo, organização e continuidade.



Direcionamento Final

Se você busca participar de projetos estruturados, com alto nível de exigência e impacto real na entrega ao cliente, essa é uma oportunidade para atuar com profundidade e consistência em um material relevante.


Do nosso lado, garantimos um processo de avaliação ágil e respeitoso com seu tempo. Desde já, agradecemos sua atenção e interesse

title: Back End Developer With Data Exp
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back End Developer With Data Exp em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role: Data Engineer III (API) / Software Engineer with Data Experience

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Mode: Contract


Important:

We need a senior-level engineer with recent hands-on experience in Node.js and strong expertise in MongoDB, TypeScript, SQL, AWS, and API development .

Experience with GraphQL is a plus .


About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled backend/data engineer with strong experience in building scalable APIs and working with complex data systems.

This role focuses on Node.js, TypeScript, backend architecture, and data modeling , with exposure to cloud-native and event-driven systems .


Responsibilities

• Build and maintain scalable APIs (REST & GraphQL) for high-performance applications

• Design and optimize data models using MongoDB, NoSQL, and relational databases

• Implement schema design, indexing strategies, and transactions for performance and scalability

• Develop and maintain ETL pipelines and data ingestion workflows

• Collaborate on backend architecture , including microservices and distributed systems

• Work with cloud platforms (AWS/OCI) and containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes)

• Ensure code quality, testing, and best engineering practices across the development lifecycle


Requirements

• 6+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering

• Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript (recent projects required)

• Expertise in MongoDB and database modeling (NoSQL + SQL)

• Solid experience building REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus)

• Strong understanding of software engineering principles (SOLID, clean architecture, design patterns)

• Experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, etc.) or OCI

• Experience with containers (Docker/Kubernetes)

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills


Nice to Have

• Experience with GraphQL APIs

• Messaging systems like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS/SNS

• Experience with event-driven architecture

• Exposure to serverless architectures

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, etc.)

title: Analista Suporte SR
description:

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Suporte Técnico N1/N2: Atendimento remoto e presencial a usuários finais, realizando recepção, análise, categorização e encerramento de chamados via ferramenta ITSM.
  • Gestão de Incidentes e SLAs: Validar severidade e impacto de chamados, garantindo o cumprimento rigoroso dos prazos acordados.

  • Gestão de Ativos: Controle de inventário, gestão de peças sobressalentes e execução de rollouts.
  • Projetos e Escalas: Apoio operacional em projetos das plantas e disponibilidade para atendimentos fora do expediente (escalas/finais de semana) quando necessário.



Gestão de Dados e Métricas

  • Garantir a precisão dos registros (categorização ITIL, tempos de resolução e status).

title: Analista de Estratégia Financeira
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Estratégia Financeira em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Seja bem-vindo(a) à página do Sicoob Engecred!

Há 25 anos no mercado financeiro, o Sicoob Engecred figura entre as maiores cooperativas do Sistema Sicoob, com R$ 4,2 bilhões em ativos totais e cerca de 25 mil cooperados em todas as regiões do país, por meio da associação digital.

Temos em nosso DNA o interesse genuíno pelas pessoas, seja dentro da cooperativa – o que nos levou a conquistar 19 premiações em rankings regionais e nacionais do Great Place to Work (GPTW) -, ou junto aos nossos associados, oferecendo soluções financeiras adequadas e com taxas justas. Isto sem falar nos benefícios que geramos nas comunidades onde atuamos, fomentando negócios e promovendo diversas ações sociais por meio do Instituto Sicoob.

Classificada como A+(bra) pela Fitch Ratings, a instituição tem seus números auditados pela Deloitte. Em 2024, se tornou a primeira cooperativa do Sistema Sicoob, em Goiás, a conquistar a Categoria Plena pelo Banco Central e, também, a obter o selo Empresa Limpa, feitos que reforçam sua credibilidade e postura ética.


Com sede em Goiânia (GO), atualmente possui agências físicas em Goiás e Minas Gerais, além de escritórios de negócios em Betim (MG), Juiz de Fora (MG), Brasília (DF), Campo Grande (MS), Campinas (SP) e São Paulo (SP).


Seguimos em busca de soluções e experiências inovadoras e sustentáveis para, por meio da cooperação, viabilizar o desenvolvimento econômico e social de comunidades.


Junte-se a nós, faça parte desta jornada de sucesso!


Analista de Estratégia Financeira


Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas afins;
  • Vivência prévia em tesouraria, estratégia financeira, controladoria ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em precificação, análise de rentabilidade e conceitos de risco financeiro;
  • Possuir CEA.

Descrição das Atividades:

  • Estruturar, manter e evoluir modelos de precificação de produtos e operações financeiras, considerando custo de funding, despesas, risco, capital e estratégia comercial;
  • Desenvolver e aplicar metodologias de retorno ajustado ao risco (Raroc), apoiando decisões de alocação de capital, definição de spreads e priorização de negócios;
  • Estruturar e manter análises de ALM (Asset & Liability Management), incluindo simulações de cenários, impactos de liquidez, sensibilidade a taxas de juros e equilíbrio entre ativos e passivos;
  • Conectar as análises financeiras da Tesouraria ao planejamento estratégico da cooperativa, traduzindo diretrizes estratégicas em parâmetros financeiros e indicadores mensuráveis;
  • Desenvolver estudos e análises de apoio à tomada de decisão estratégica, incluindo cenários, projeções e avaliação de impactos econômico-financeiros;
  • Apoiar a definição e revisão de políticas financeiras, metodologias de precificação e critérios de rentabilidade;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as demais áreas da cooperativa.


Benefícios:

vale-alimentação/refeição de R$ 2.022,85, vale-transporte, plano de saúde Unimed, plano odontológico Uniodonto, auxílio-creche/babá, bolsa de estudos, seguro de vida, Gympass, Zenklub, previdência privada, adicional por tempo de casa, participação nos resultados e plano de carreira.

title: Human Resources Shared Services & Payroll Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Human Resources Shared Services & Payroll Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary:

Under general direction, the HR Shared Services & Payroll Specialist is responsible for executing payroll operations for the United States and delivering HR shared services support across the employee lifecycle for the United States and Brazil. This role ensures accurate and timely payroll processing, maintains HR data integrity, and provides high-quality support to employees and managers. The position partners with HR, Finance, and business stakeholders to ensure compliance, efficiency, and a positive employee experience.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Processes payroll for the United States employees, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance
  • Reviews and validates payroll inputs including hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, and deductions
  • Audits payroll data and resolve discrepancies prior to payroll finalization
  • Supports payroll compliance with applicable laws, tax regulations, and company policies
  • Maintains payroll records, documentation, and audit trails
  • Executes HR shared services transactions including hires, terminations, transfers, and employee data changes
  • Ensures data accuracy across HRIS, payroll, and related systems
  • Responds to employee and manager inquiries related to payroll, HR processes, and policies
  • Partners with HR, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure accurate employee lifecycle processing
  • Supports reconciliations including payroll, benefits, and general ledger alignment
  • Assists with year-end processes such as tax reporting and annual compensation cycles
  • Coordinates with vendors and systems to ensure smooth payroll and HR operations
  • Identifies and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy
  • Ensures compliance with internal controls, audits, and documentation standards
  • Provides reporting and insights on payroll and HR operations metrics


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 6-8 years of payroll, HR operations, or shared services
  • Knowledge of payroll processes, tax regulations, and compliance requirements for the United States
  • Experience with payroll systems (e.g., ADP Total Source or similar)
  • Experience working with payroll systems and vendors
  • Strong knowledge of payroll regulations, tax requirements, and compliance across multiple jurisdictions for the United States
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Products (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams)
  • Proficiency in English and the local language of the country or region supported, including strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information
  • Ability to work collaboratively across business teams
  • Ability to make timely and effective decisions
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage sensitive data
  • Ability to adapt to changing business needs
  • Communication skills in both verbal and in writing
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Strong Critical thinking skills
  • Strong Customer Service skills
  • Strong Problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting global payroll operations
  • Familiarity with HRIS systems and integrations
  • Payroll-related certification(s)

Work Environment:

  • The role will be performed in a manufacturing setting with frequent exposure to equipment and machinery.
  • May require occasional travel between plant locations and corporate offices.
  • Flexibility to work in both an office and a plant environment is required.

title: Emerging Market Trader - LATAM (BRL, MXN, ARS)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader - LATAM (BRL, MXN, ARS) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in LATAM currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities:


FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on LATAM markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.

Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.

Trading Infrastructure & Systems

Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:

  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.

Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.


Requirements

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.

Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: LATAM (BRL, MXN, ARS)

Experience working at:

  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks

Hands-on experience building or optimizing:

  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.

Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

title: Analista de Estratégia Financeira
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Estratégia Financeira em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Seja bem-vindo(a) à página do Sicoob Engecred!

Há 25 anos no mercado financeiro, o Sicoob Engecred figura entre as maiores cooperativas do Sistema Sicoob, com R$ 4,2 bilhões em ativos totais e cerca de 25 mil cooperados em todas as regiões do país, por meio da associação digital.

Temos em nosso DNA o interesse genuíno pelas pessoas, seja dentro da cooperativa – o que nos levou a conquistar 19 premiações em rankings regionais e nacionais do Great Place to Work (GPTW) -, ou junto aos nossos associados, oferecendo soluções financeiras adequadas e com taxas justas. Isto sem falar nos benefícios que geramos nas comunidades onde atuamos, fomentando negócios e promovendo diversas ações sociais por meio do Instituto Sicoob.

Classificada como A+(bra) pela Fitch Ratings, a instituição tem seus números auditados pela Deloitte. Em 2024, se tornou a primeira cooperativa do Sistema Sicoob, em Goiás, a conquistar a Categoria Plena pelo Banco Central e, também, a obter o selo Empresa Limpa, feitos que reforçam sua credibilidade e postura ética.


Com sede em Goiânia (GO), atualmente possui agências físicas em Goiás e Minas Gerais, além de escritórios de negócios em Betim (MG), Juiz de Fora (MG), Brasília (DF), Campo Grande (MS), Campinas (SP) e São Paulo (SP).


Seguimos em busca de soluções e experiências inovadoras e sustentáveis para, por meio da cooperação, viabilizar o desenvolvimento econômico e social de comunidades.


Junte-se a nós, faça parte desta jornada de sucesso!


Analista de Estratégia Financeira


Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas afins;
  • Vivência prévia em tesouraria, estratégia financeira, controladoria ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em precificação, análise de rentabilidade e conceitos de risco financeiro;
  • Possuir CEA.

Descrição das Atividades:

  • Estruturar, manter e evoluir modelos de precificação de produtos e operações financeiras, considerando custo de funding, despesas, risco, capital e estratégia comercial;
  • Desenvolver e aplicar metodologias de retorno ajustado ao risco (Raroc), apoiando decisões de alocação de capital, definição de spreads e priorização de negócios;
  • Estruturar e manter análises de ALM (Asset & Liability Management), incluindo simulações de cenários, impactos de liquidez, sensibilidade a taxas de juros e equilíbrio entre ativos e passivos;
  • Conectar as análises financeiras da Tesouraria ao planejamento estratégico da cooperativa, traduzindo diretrizes estratégicas em parâmetros financeiros e indicadores mensuráveis;
  • Desenvolver estudos e análises de apoio à tomada de decisão estratégica, incluindo cenários, projeções e avaliação de impactos econômico-financeiros;
  • Apoiar a definição e revisão de políticas financeiras, metodologias de precificação e critérios de rentabilidade;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as demais áreas da cooperativa.


Benefícios:

vale-alimentação/refeição de R$ 2.022,85, vale-transporte, plano de saúde Unimed, plano odontológico Uniodonto, auxílio-creche/babá, bolsa de estudos, seguro de vida, Gympass, Zenklub, previdência privada, adicional por tempo de casa, participação nos resultados e plano de carreira.

Com sede em Goiânia (GO), atualmente possui agências físicas em Goiás e Minas Gerais, além de escritórios de negócios em Betim (MG), Juiz de Fora (MG), Brasília (DF), Campo Grande (MS), Campinas (SP) e São Paulo (SP).


Seguimos em busca de soluções e experiências inovadoras e sustentáveis para, por meio da cooperação, viabilizar o desenvolvimento econômico e social de comunidades.


Junte-se a nós, faça parte desta jornada de sucesso!


Analista de Estratégia Financeira


Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas afins;
  • Vivência prévia em tesouraria, estratégia financeira, controladoria ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em precificação, análise de rentabilidade e conceitos de risco financeiro;
  • Possuir CEA.

Descrição das Atividades:

  • Estruturar, manter e evoluir modelos de precificação de produtos e operações financeiras, considerando custo de funding, despesas, risco, capital e estratégia comercial;
  • Desenvolver e aplicar metodologias de retorno ajustado ao risco (Raroc), apoiando decisões de alocação de capital, definição de spreads e priorização de negócios;
  • Estruturar e manter análises de ALM (Asset & Liability Management), incluindo simulações de cenários, impactos de liquidez, sensibilidade a taxas de juros e equilíbrio entre ativos e passivos;
  • Conectar as análises financeiras da Tesouraria ao planejamento estratégico da cooperativa, traduzindo diretrizes estratégicas em parâmetros financeiros e indicadores mensuráveis;
  • Desenvolver estudos e análises de apoio à tomada de decisão estratégica, incluindo cenários, projeções e avaliação de impactos econômico-financeiros;
  • Apoiar a definição e revisão de políticas financeiras, metodologias de precificação e critérios de rentabilidade;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as demais áreas da cooperativa.


Benefícios:

vale-alimentação/refeição de R$ 2.022,85, vale-transporte, plano de saúde Unimed, plano odontológico Uniodonto, auxílio-creche/babá, bolsa de estudos, seguro de vida, Gympass, Zenklub, previdência privada, adicional por tempo de casa, participação nos resultados e plano de carreira.

title: Human Resources Shared Services & Payroll Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Human Resources Shared Services & Payroll Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary:

Under general direction, the HR Shared Services & Payroll Specialist is responsible for executing payroll operations for the United States and delivering HR shared services support across the employee lifecycle for the United States and Brazil. This role ensures accurate and timely payroll processing, maintains HR data integrity, and provides high-quality support to employees and managers. The position partners with HR, Finance, and business stakeholders to ensure compliance, efficiency, and a positive employee experience.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Processes payroll for the United States employees, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance
  • Reviews and validates payroll inputs including hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, and deductions
  • Audits payroll data and resolve discrepancies prior to payroll finalization
  • Supports payroll compliance with applicable laws, tax regulations, and company policies
  • Maintains payroll records, documentation, and audit trails
  • Executes HR shared services transactions including hires, terminations, transfers, and employee data changes
  • Ensures data accuracy across HRIS, payroll, and related systems
  • Responds to employee and manager inquiries related to payroll, HR processes, and policies
  • Partners with HR, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure accurate employee lifecycle processing
  • Supports reconciliations including payroll, benefits, and general ledger alignment
  • Assists with year-end processes such as tax reporting and annual compensation cycles
  • Coordinates with vendors and systems to ensure smooth payroll and HR operations
  • Identifies and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy
  • Ensures compliance with internal controls, audits, and documentation standards
  • Provides reporting and insights on payroll and HR operations metrics


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 6-8 years of payroll, HR operations, or shared services
  • Knowledge of payroll processes, tax regulations, and compliance requirements for the United States
  • Experience with payroll systems (e.g., ADP Total Source or similar)
  • Experience working with payroll systems and vendors
  • Strong knowledge of payroll regulations, tax requirements, and compliance across multiple jurisdictions for the United States
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Products (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams)
  • Proficiency in English and the local language of the country or region supported, including strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information
  • Ability to work collaboratively across business teams
  • Ability to make timely and effective decisions
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage sensitive data
  • Ability to adapt to changing business needs
  • Communication skills in both verbal and in writing
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Strong Critical thinking skills
  • Strong Customer Service skills
  • Strong Problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting global payroll operations
  • Familiarity with HRIS systems and integrations
  • Payroll-related certification(s)

Work Environment:

  • The role will be performed in a manufacturing setting with frequent exposure to equipment and machinery.
  • May require occasional travel between plant locations and corporate offices.
  • Flexibility to work in both an office and a plant environment is required.

title: Analista de Relacionamento Institucional Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Relacionamento Institucional Sênior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira, referência em soluções energéticas e se colocando à frente das próximas inovações do setor para construir um amanhã melhor a partir de uma matriz mais limpa.


Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Relacionamento Institucional Sênior para fazer parte do nosso time em São Paulo-SP .


Acreditamos que a diversidade é fundamental para o nosso crescimento e da nossa sociedade como um todo. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são abertas para todas as pessoas, independente da origem, gênero, cor, orientação sexual, crenças.


Esta oportunidade também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PCD), alinhada ao nosso compromisso com a inclusão e a diversidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com entidades setoriais, stakeholders do Executivo, Legislativo e agências reguladoras em todas as esferas (federal, estadual e municipal), conduzindo agendas de complexidade variável, previamente alinhadas com a gerência, reportando percepções, oportunidades e recomendações;
  • Avaliar projetos de lei, regulamentos e políticas públicas, identificando riscos, impactos e oportunidades estratégicas, e traduzindo-os em análises críticas e recomendações para a coordenação e gerência, suportando decisões institucionais;
  • Fornecer análises aprofundadas, insights estratégicos e recomendações que orientem planos de engajamento com stakeholders, contribuindo para a construção de posicionamentos consistentes e alinhados aos objetivos corporativos;
  • Preparar cenários detalhados, relatórios e apresentações que reforcem a atuação da liderança, apoiando interlocuções estratégicas e fortalecendo a presença institucional da companhia;
  • Garantir que todas as iniciativas e posicionamentos institucionais estejam alinhados às políticas internas, normas regulatórias e princípios de compliance, revisando documentos e processos críticos, e assessorando a liderança em decisões estratégicas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa em Direito, Economia, Comunicação Social, Relações Internacionais, Ciência Política, Gestão Pública ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês – Nível: Avançado;
  • Espanhol – Nível: Básico;
  • Domínio do funcionamento da administração pública e dos processos legislativos e regulatórios em todas as esferas (federal, estadual e municipal);
  • Capacidade de interpretar cenários políticos complexos e traduzir riscos e oportunidades em insumos acionáveis para a coordenação e a gerência;
  • Experiência em interlocução institucional e representação da empresa em fóruns, associações e reuniões com stakeholders públicos;
  • Experiência em associações setoriais ou consultorias de public affairs;
  • Capacidade de produzir, validar e qualificar materiais estratégicos (notas técnicas, position papers, relatórios executivos, briefings);
  • Articulação política e institucional e comunicação clara, segura e persuasiva (oral e escrita);
  • Capacidade analítica e visão crítica;
  • Capacidade de orientar e apoiar o desenvolvimento de Plenos e Juniores;
  • Ética, integridade e aderência às políticas de compliance em interações com stakeholders.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Pós-Graduação em Relações Governamentais, Direito Regulatório, Políticas Públicas, Gestão de Negócios ou Comunicação Institucional.
  • Vivência prévia em empresas de setores regulados (energia, petróleo e gás, infraestrutura, telecomunicações, saúde, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em políticas públicas e análise regulatória comparada (benchmark internacional);
  • Noções avançadas de direito regulatório, administrativo e constitucional.
  • Visão sistêmica de negócios e regulação do setor;
  • Capacidade de negociação em ambientes complexos;
  • Resiliência e adaptabilidade em cenários de incerteza.

Ready to shape the future of work?

At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change—we drive it. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and we’re leading the charge. Master Data Operations

  • Manage day‑to‑day master data operations, ensuring timely and accurate execution of assigned tasks.
  • Maintain vendor, material, and service master records (creation, updates, modifications, deletions) in alignment with SLA requirements across multiple regions.
  • Perform data cleaning, enrichment, and standardization activities to improve overall data quality.


Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with global governance requirements and internal sourcing policies, including ethics, environmental stewardship, social responsibility, localization, and health & safety standards.
  • Collaborate with internal and external audit teams, preparing documentation, evidence, and supporting materials to address findings and implement recommended actions.


Vendor Management

  • Drive centralized vendor management by maintaining accurate records, consistent classification, and risk validation.
  • Establish and monitor vendor accounts, including non‑preferred vendor listings, to ensure compliance and sustainability reporting.
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enrichment of vendor data to support continuous improvement.


Continuous Improvement & Systems Support

Track, measure, and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to master data processes.

  • Coordinate with UAT teams to support testing, validation, and deployment of system or process changes.
  • Prepare operational and analytical reports, and support automation of recurring tasks.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Respond to client and supplier queries, providing timely and effective resolutions within stipulated timeframes.

  • Expertise in material and vendor master data, with familiarity in MDM tools (e.g., SAP MDG, Informatica).

  • Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues
  • Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement
  • Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs.

description:
